code: simulate_task = function(n_seq, n_data = 200L) {   signal = vector("list", n_seq)   label = vector("list", n_seq)   for (i in seq_len(n_seq)) {     noise = exp(runif(1L, log(0.5), log(5)))     if (i %% 2L == 1L) {       change = sample(80:120, 1L)       signal[[i]] = c(rnorm(change, 0, noise), rnorm(n_data - change, 3 * noise, noise))       label[[i]] = data.table(         start = c(1, change - 10),         end = c(change - 20, change + 10),         label = c("0changes", "1change")       )     } else {       signal[[i]] = rnorm(n_data, 0, noise)       label[[i]] = data.table(start = 1, end = n_data, label = "0changes")     }   }   TaskCpt$new(     id = paste0("simulated_", n_seq), backend = data.table(signal = signal, label = label),     target = "label", sequence = "signal", label_type = "changepoint"   ) } has_mmit = requireNamespace("mmit", quietly = TRUE) learners = list(   lrn("changepoint.featureless", Kmax = 2L),   lrn("changepoint.intregrcv", Kmax = 2L, n.folds = 2L, min.observations = 2L),   lrn("changepoint.xgboost.aft", Kmax = 2L) ) if (has_mmit) {   learners = c(learners, lrns(c("changepoint.mmit", "changepoint.mmif"), Kmax = 2L)) }

title: mlr3changepoint 0.1.0
text: Initial CRAN submission. New "changepoint" task type weakly supervised changepoint peak detection, registered mlr3 package loads. Every prediction records Kmax learned extra data, measures plots decode segmentation, also wrapped (GraphLearner, AutoTuner) resampled learners. autoplot() methods TaskCpt PredictionCpt draw sequences labelled regions, segmentation selected predicted penalty, ROC curve (type = "roc"). LearnerCpt abstract base class changepoint learners. LearnerCptFeatureless (changepoint.featureless) baseline predicts one constant penalty fewest training label errors. LearnerCptIntRegrCV (changepoint.intregrcv) learns penalty penaltyLearning::IntervalRegressionCV(). LearnerCptMMIF (changepoint.mmif) learns penalty max margin interval forest mmit. LearnerCptMMIT (changepoint.mmit) learns penalty max margin interval tree mmit. LearnerCptXGBoostAFT (changepoint.xgboost.aft) learns penalty xgboost’s accelerated failure time objective. MeasureCpt abstract base class changepoint measures. MeasureCptAUC (changepoint.auc) area ROC curve traced shifting every predicted penalty. MeasureCptLabelAccuracy (changepoint.label_accuracy) one minus label error. MeasureCptLabelError (changepoint.label_error) share labelled regions predicted segmentation gets wrong. PredictionCpt holds predicted log(lambda) per sequence. TaskCpt holds one labelled sequence per row, "changepoint" "peak" labels.
